get.summary: Get context for a specific game
get.description: Returns player IDs, manpowers, periods, and shootout information for a specific game.

parameters.name: mps
parameters.description: Filter: manpowerSituation. Using multiple manpower filters: for every mpsskater and/or mpsteamid, it is required to have a corresponding mps. When passing multiple of these parameters, they must be in the same order in their respective lists. For example, if trying to filter a query to ES-5v4 or PP-4v3, then the params can be passed as: mps[]=ES&mpsskaters[]=5v4&mps[]=PP&mpsskaters[]=4v3 OR mps[]=ES&mps[]=PP&mpsskaters[]=5v4&mpsskaters[]=4v3 OR mpsskaters[]=5v4&mpsskaters[]=4v3&mps[]=ES&mps[]=PP

parameters.name: mpsskaters
parameters.description: Filter manpower where {teamskatersonicecount}v{opposingteamskatersonicecount}, ex: 5v4.  Using multiple manpower filters: for every mpsskater and/or mpsteamid, it is required to have a corresponding mps. When passing multiple of these parameters, they must be in the same order in their respective lists. For example, if trying to filter a query to ES-5v4 or PP-4v3, then the params can be passed as: mps[]=ES&mpsskaters[]=5v4&mps[]=PP&mpsskaters[]=4v3 OR mps[]=ES&mps[]=PP&mpsskaters[]=5v4&mpsskaters[]=4v3 OR mpsskaters[]=5v4&mpsskaters[]=4v3&mps[]=ES&mps[]=PP
